applicability: Source-backed research, code analysis, guidance, root-cause investigation, and learning with a concrete demonstration and separate practice/answer artifacts. Structured research compiles objectives, methods, results, discussion and mapped questions into this same recipe.
limitations: Format and provenance validation cannot establish semantic correctness.
External sources record their retrieval date; automatic remote freshness is unavailable.
Observed outcomes require actual passing evidence; expected results remain labelled expected.
Manual practice is supported only by validated structured research with explicit procedure steps; format validation does not execute those steps or establish learner completion.

parameter_schema.note: Complete CornellInput: visible path, topic, kind, context, constraints, cues, main_notes, sources, demonstration, failure_cases, practice, summary, optional engineering links. cornell_research_compile produces the optional research metadata and question/objective mapping deterministically; pass its recipe_input to existing recipe_prepare. Legacy CornellInput remains supported.
